title: The World's Longest Dragon Dance Ran 6,500 Meters | China Travel Expert
description:
The world's longest dragon dance stretched an astonishing 6,500 meters — one continuous dragon, brought to life by a whole team moving in sync.

A dragon dance isn't one costume: dancers lift the body on poles and chase a "pearl" down the street. Small dragons need a dozen people; the biggest take well over a hundred, all timed to the same drum.

🧭 Expert Tip: The best time to catch a dragon dance is Lunar New Year and local temple fairs — arrive early and stand near a corner where the dragon turns.

一条龙、一支队、一个鼓点——世界最长的舞龙长达6500米，小龙十几人，大龙上百人。
